full_prompt_en: An oil portrait painting shows a young man from the chest upward against a nearly black background. He turns slightly to the left but looks outward, his expression reserved and attentive. Light brown hair is swept back in short, irregular strokes; pale skin is built from planes of cream, warm peach, cool gray, and faint ocher. A white high collar opens at the throat above a dark navy-black coat whose shoulders merge into the background. The composition is close and simple, giving most of the square frame to the head and upper torso. Light enters from the upper left, striking the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheek, and collar, while the opposite side of the face becomes a cooler half-shadow. The paint surface is clearly worked: broad blocky strokes model the temple and jaw, short directional marks describe hair, and darker dragged strokes give the coat and ground a rough matte quality. Some edges are crisp at the illuminated face and collar, while others dissolve where dark clothing meets dark ground. The limited palette avoids decorative color and relies on the balance of pale flesh, white cloth, and dense blue-black. The image feels psychologically concentrated, with visible brushwork preventing the careful likeness from becoming photographic. Its quiet force comes from the direct gaze, compact crop, and thickly layered but restrained paint.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅油画肖像，表现一位青年从胸部以上立于近乎黑色的背景前。他身体略向左转，目光却望向画外，神情克制而专注。浅棕色短发以不规则短笔触向后梳；浅色皮肤由奶油白、暖桃色、冷灰和淡赭色的平面构成。白色高领在喉部敞开，下面是深海军蓝近黑的外套，肩膀融入背景。构图亲近而简单，正方形画面大部分交给头部和上半身。光从左上方进入，照在额头、鼻梁、面颊和领口上，脸的另一侧化为偏冷的半影。颜料表面显然经过反复塑造：宽而块状的笔触塑造太阳穴和下颌，短小定向笔触描写头发，深色拖笔给外套和背景粗糙哑光质地。受光的脸与领口边缘较清楚，深衣服与深背景交接处则消失。有限配色避免装饰性颜色，只靠浅色皮肤、白布与浓重蓝黑取得平衡。图像在心理上很集中，可见笔触使准确的相貌不变成照片。直接的目光、紧凑裁切和厚而克制的颜料层次，构成安静的力量。
style_prompt_en: Restrained oil painting with broad blocky strokes, short directional marks, and a visibly worked matte surface. Cream, peach, cool gray, faint ocher, white, and dense blue-black create a narrow tonal palette. Upper-left light catches the central planes and a small pale accent, leaving the opposite side in cool half-shadow. Edges sharpen at illuminated transitions and disappear where dark masses meet a near-black ground. The crop is compact and psychologically focused, with tactile paint carrying form more strongly than smooth blending or decorative detail.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的油画风格，宽而块状的笔触、短小定向痕迹与经过反复加工的哑光表面清晰可见。奶油白、桃色、冷灰、淡赭、白色及浓蓝黑构成狭窄色阶。左上方的光抓住中心平面和一小处浅色点缀，另一侧留在冷色半影里。受光转折处边缘变清楚，深色体块碰到近黑底色时消失。裁切紧凑，心理感受集中，以可触的颜料而非平滑融合或装饰细节塑造形体。
theme_en: A young man in a dark coat against a near-black ground
theme_zh: 深色外套青年立于近黑背景前
name: Luc Tuymans
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
